mapper.insert: INSERT INTO studies (title, description, max_participants, start_date, duration, creator_id) VALUES (#{studyDto.title}, #{studyDto.description}, #{studyDto.maxParticipants}, #{studyDto.startDate}, #{studyDto.duration}, #{studyDto.creatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.title, s.description, s.max_participants AS maxParticipants, s.start_date AS startDate, s.duration, s.creator_id AS creatorId, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name) AS tags FROM studies s LEFT JOIN study_tags st ON s.id = st.study_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON st.tag_id = t.id GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT s.id, s.title, s.description, s.max_participants AS maxParticipants, s.current_participants AS currentParticipants, s.start_date AS startDate, s.duration, s.creator_id AS creatorId, GROUP_CONCAT(t.name) AS tags FROM studies s LEFT JOIN study_tags st ON s.id = st.study_id LEFT JOIN tags t ON st.tag_id = t.id WHERE s.id = #{studyId} GROUP BY s.id;
